answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. By the quartz of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. A thread of per-task receipts records who did what, and the wharf of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, forfeited on duplicate submission, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work.
